Package dev.ucomprotocol.spi

Interface CommerceAdapter

All Known Implementing Classes:
Ap2CommerceAdapter, MockCommerceAdapter, ResilientCommerceAdapter
public interface CommerceAdapter
Main SPI interface for UCP adapters. Implementations should provide access to specific capability adapters.
